title: Normalized district budget record, schema version 1.0
description: One record per district-fiscal-year. Deliberately minimal: the current-year stated revenue and education-fund receipts, the current-year stated expenditure total, the prior-year actuals for the education fund and for total expenditure, and the per-town stated tax figures. A null money value means the source document did not publish that figure; it never means it was not looked for. The validator enforces that guarantee by requiring every null to be accounted for in `not_published` or `lines_flagged`.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was extracted under.

entity.description: Registry slug of the district or supervisory union this budget belongs to.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year the budget covers. FY2027 = the year ending June 30, 2027.

status.description: Where in its lifecycle this budget was when the source document was published. A district-fiscal-year may legitimately have several records at different statuses; they are distinct rows, not revisions of one row.

source.description: Repo-relative path to the raw intake artifact this record was extracted from. CI rejects any record whose source path does not exist.

source_pages.description: Page or section reference within the source artifact, e.g. 'pp. 14-17'. Makes a record checkable by hand in under a minute.

adopted_date.description: Date of the Town Meeting or board vote that adopted this budget, where applicable. Null for proposed/warned records.

extracted_by.description: Who performed or confirmed the extraction. Free text; a name or handle.

revenues.description: The current-year stated total revenue, the education-fund receipts within it, and the prior year's actual education-fund figure as printed in this document.

education_fund.description: Statewide Education Fund receipts for this fiscal year -- the main revenue line for most Vermont districts.

education_fund_previous_year_actual.description: The actual (not budgeted) education-fund receipts for the prior fiscal year, as printed in this document's comparison column.

total_stated.description: Total revenue for this fiscal year as printed in the document.

expenditures.description: The current-year stated expenditure total and the prior year's actual expenditure total as printed in this document.

total_stated.description: Total expenditure for this fiscal year as printed in the document.

previous_year_actual.description: The actual (not budgeted) total expenditure for the prior fiscal year, as printed in this document's comparison column.

towns.description: One entry per member town, with the rate and CLA as stated in this document. Tax Department published CLAs and rates are joined separately and labeled as the state's figures.

homestead_rate_stated.description: Homestead education property tax rate in dollars per $100 of equalized value, as printed.

cla.description: Common Level of Appraisal as a ratio (0.8734), not a percentage (87.34).

not_published.description: Dotted paths of fields this source document does not publish, each confirmed absent by a human rather than merely skipped. The validator requires that every null in the record appears here or in lines_flagged. This is what makes a null mean 'the district did not publish it' instead of 'we did not look'.

lines_flagged.description: Anything that did not fit cleanly: figures that do not reconcile, apparent errors in the source, judgement calls made during extraction, or an essential figure not yet transcribed.
